text: Scenes beyond boxes: switchable geometry, things that move
description: The skyscraper boxes are one scene of several. Each scene gets a control tab with an on switch and its settings (city, creatures, ...), so they can be mixed or swapped live. Moving geometry matters: the net and the reprojection get velocity to work with, not only head motion. Candidates: creatures, flocks, falling/rising things, procedural plants, the twisted crystals.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Soft bodies that lag and smear look alive and artistic, more than replayed rigid animation

status.comment: Control tabs with switches: city (blocks on/off, ground plate stays) and creatures (commit after 588c366).
